title: Retail Installment Contracts System Reference: Booking a Late Charge
content:
**Policy entry.** On Retail Installment Contracts, a late charge is booked on the oldest unpaid installment of an active contract once that installment's late-charge grace period has ended. That installment is the one due on the contract's next due date. The late charge is recorded against that installment's due date, and it becomes part of the contract's fees due.

## Capability

`assess_late_charge_1a8e6313` books one late charge on one installment of a borrower's retail installment contract. One call adds a single late-charge entry, dated today, to the contract's money history for the installment named, and raises the contract's fees due by the amount charged; the borrower sees the late charge on the contract and in the fees owed. The tool records the amount it is given; it does not work out the amount.

## How it is invoked

This is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `assess_late_charge_1a8e6313` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `contract_id` | the contract reference number of the retail installment contract being charged, as returned by the contract lookup for the verified borrower | text identifier |
| `installment_due_date` | the due date of the installment the late charge is for | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time or time zone; never empty for this charge |
| `amount_usd` | the late charge amount | USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 or more; stored rounded half-up to the cent exactly as passed |

## Return

A receipt rendered as text with `contract_txn_id` (the ledger reference of the new late-charge entry), `contract_id` (the contract charged), `installment_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD of the installment charged), `amount_usd` (the late charge booked, 2 decimal places), `fees_due_usd` (the contract's fees due including this charge, 2 decimal places) and `status`, the text booked, meaning the charge is now owed on the contract. A receipt carrying the new ledger reference means the charge is booked.

**Illustration (hypothetical input).** Booking a charge of 14.37 for the installment due 2031-04-09 on a contract with 0.00 fees due returns a receipt whose fees due read 14.37 and whose status reads booked.
